stemMd: Two horizontal forces of 8 N east and 6 N north act on a stationary point object. What third force would give equilibrium?

options.label: E
options.textMd: 10 N directed southwest, with components 8 N west and 6 N south

explanationMd: The first two forces have resultant magnitude square root of 64+36=10 N. Equilibrium requires its exact opposite, with west and south components cancelling each original component.

distractorRationale.d: This fails to cancel the east component.
distractorRationale.c: This reinforces rather than cancels the resultant.
distractorRationale.a: This adds magnitudes and ignores the north component.
distractorRationale.b: This subtracts magnitudes without vector balance.
